treatments.monitoring: PHASE 1 (Weeks 1-4): Baseline — court technology adoption using NCSC tech maturity assessment. Deliverable: baseline report. PHASE 2 (Months 2-3): Early tracking — court technology adoption measured biannually. Target: e-filing in 80% of courts. PHASE 3 (Months 4-6): Midpoint review — compare against NCSC technology benchmark. Target: 50% of goal. PHASE 4 (Months 7-12): Maturation — court technology adoption trending toward 90% e-filing. Escalate if <60% e-filing floor. ANNUAL REVIEW: Comprehensive audit using NCSC Technology Framework. Report to Court Technology Director.
treatments.escalation: If target outcome shows no measurable improvement after 90 days, or if implementation barriers prevent protocol adherence for >14 consecutive days, escalate to a legal profession regulation specialist for root cause analysis and intervention redesign. If the intervention produces adverse unintended effects at any point, pause implementation and request specialist review within 14 days.
